action.description: The subcommand to run: sign, extract-data, add, attach-signature, extract-signature, remove-signature, verify.

input_file.description: Path to the input file to process.

output_file.description: Path to the output file. Empty for verify command.

pkcs12_file.description: Path to the PKCS#12 file containing the signing certificate and key.

password.description: Password for the PKCS#12 or key file. Prefer pass_file for security.

pass_file.description: Path to file containing the password/PIN to read from.

certs_file.description: Path to signing certificate chain file (PEM or SPC).

key_file.description: Path to private key file or PKCS#11 URI.

ac_file.description: Path to file with additional certificates to include in the signature.

pkcs11_cert.description: PKCS#11 URI identifying the certificate object.

engine.description: OpenSSL engine identifier or path to dynamic engine module.

pkcs11_login.description: Force login to the token for engine-based PKCS#11 use.

engine_ctrls.description: List of engine control commands in format 'command' or 'command:parameter'.

nolegacy.description: Do not automatically load the legacy provider on OpenSSL 3.

digest.description: Digest algorithm: md5, sha1, sha2, sha256, sha384, sha512.

info_url.description: Informational URL associated with the signed content.

comm.description: Use Microsoft Commercial Code Signing purpose.

ph.description: Generate page hashes for executable files.

add_msi_dse.description: Enable MsiDigitalSignatureEx signing mode for MSI files.

pem.description: Write PKCS#7 output in PEM format.

add_unauthenticated_blob.description: Add an unauthenticated blob to the signature.

blob_file.description: Read blob contents from this file.

timestamp_auth_url.description: List of Authenticode timestamp server URLs.

timestamp_rfc3161_url.description: List of RFC 3161 timestamp server URLs.

proxy.description: Proxy used for timestamp or CRL retrieval.

https_ca_file.description: PEM bundle used to verify HTTPS peers (timestamp servers).

https_crl_file.description: PEM CRL file used while verifying HTTPS peers.

tsa_certs_file.description: PEM certificate chain for locally generated RFC 3161 timestamps.

tsa_key_file.description: Private key for locally generated RFC 3161 timestamps.

tsa_time.description: Timestamp time for locally generated RFC 3161 responses (unix-time).

nest.description: Add a nested signature instead of replacing the primary.

index.description: Select a signature by index for add or verify.

catalog_file.description: Verify the input file against this catalog file.

ca_file.description: PEM bundle of trusted CA certificates for signer validation.

crl_file.description: PEM file containing CRLs for signer validation.

tsa_ca_file.description: PEM bundle of trusted CA certificates for timestamp validation.

tsa_crl_file.description: PEM file containing CRLs for timestamp validation.

ignore_timestamp.description: Skip verification of the timestamp signature.

ignore_cdp.description: Do not fetch CRLs from CRL Distribution Points.

ignore_crl.description: Disable CRL retrieval and CRL validation.

require_leaf_hash.description: Require the signer's leaf certificate to hash to specified value (alg:hex).
